name: The Castle of Dr. Hoot
storyline:
Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles guaranteed to stump even the most well-read 5th grader!

Traverse the castle's many rooms, collect Extra Credit Points and purchase items from the school store to help you on your way. Be sure to keep an eye on your GRADE SCORE and stay alert; surprise pop quizzes are common.

Most importantly, don't get caught breaking the rules, Dr. Hoot is known to get nasty!
summary: Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles as you avoid the wrath of the strict, cranky spelling teacher, Dr. Hoot.
